body:
So in general this is a casualty of two things:

- Fetch was refactored. It used to queue specific named tasks ([these ones](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/2d0d7bdec1880ed1d7df091c9d2f7604ea9f2a9c/#process-request-body)). Now it takes specific named callbacks ([these ones](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/90ddae73fcfd8af1b13e0a9a32b3627650da760a/#fetch-elsewhere-fetch)). Many specs have not been updated, including HTML.

- The navigate algorithm has never had great fetch integration. In particular, the processing of response bodies is atrocious; it's done via algorithms like https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#read-html which say things like

   > Each [task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-task) that the [networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#networking-task-source) places on the [task queue](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#task-queue) while fetching runs must then fill the parser's [input byte stream](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-input-byte-stream) with the fetched bytes and cause the [HTML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#html-parser) to perform the appropriate processing of the input stream.
    >
    > The first [task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-task) that the [networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#networking-task-source) places on the [task queue](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#task-queue) while fetching runs must [process link headers](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#process-link-headers) given document, navigationParams's [response](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#navigation-params-response), and "media", after the task has been procesed by the [HTML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#html-parser).

The former of these I can look into fixing in https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/6315. The equivalent algorithm is https://whatpr.org/html/6315/browsing-the-web.html#create-navigation-params-by-fetching .

The latter of these is tracked by https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8095.

I think this can be closed now, since the rewrite properly integrates with Fetch in the new "equivalent" algorithm: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#create-navigation-params-by-fetching. But let me know if you think otherwise @smaug---- .
